headlines.title: 中澳（大利亚）两国央行续签双边本币互换协议
headlines.summary: 经国务院批准，近日中国人民银行与澳大利亚储备银行续签了双边本币互换协议，互换规模由原来的2000亿元人民币/410亿澳大利亚元扩大至2200亿元人民币/460亿澳大利亚元，协议有效期五年，经双方同意可以展期。 双方再次续签双边本币互换协议并扩大规模，有助于进一步深化两国货币金融合作，促进双边贸易和投资便利化，维护金融市场稳定。（中国央行网站）

headlines.title_en: Central banks of China and Australia renew bilateral local currency swap agreement
headlines.summary_en: Following State Council approval, the People's Bank of China and the Reserve Bank of Australia recently renewed their bilateral local currency swap agreement, expanding the scale from RMB 200 billion/AUD 41 billion to RMB 220 billion/AUD 46 billion. The agreement is valid for five years and can be extended by mutual consent. The renewal and expansion of the bilateral local currency swap agreement will help deepen monetary and financial cooperation between the two countries, facilitate bilateral trade and investment, and safeguard financial market stability. (PBOC website)

headlines.title_en: *ST Zhuoran: investigation progress may trigger mandatory delisting for major violations
headlines.summary_en: *ST Zhuoran announced that the company and its actual controller Zhang Jinhong have been placed under investigation by the CSRC for suspected false disclosure and other violations. It has been preliminarily found that some annual financial information disclosed by the company is suspected of containing false records, which may trigger mandatory delisting due to major violations. If the facts determined by the CSRC's administrative penalty subsequently fall under the circumstances of mandatory delisting for major violations as stipulated by relevant listing rules, the company's shares will be subject to such delisting. As of the date of this announcement, the CSRC's investigation is still ongoing, and the company will actively cooperate with the investigation and fulfill its information disclosure obligations.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Jahwa: H1 net profit of 381 million yuan, up 43.35% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Jahwa announced that for the first half of 2026, operating revenue was RMB 3.791 billion, up 8.99% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 381 million, up 43.35% year-on-year; non-GAAP net profit was RMB 352 million, up 58.92% year-on-year. The profit distribution plan is a cash dividend of RMB 0.056 per share (tax inclusive). <u>The company plans to sell its 19% equity in Sephora Shanghai and 19% equity in Sephora Beijing to Sephora Asia for EUR 70 million (approximately RMB 555 million)</u>. The transaction has been approved by the company's Ninth Board of Directors' ninth meeting and is still subject to shareholder meeting approval and completion of foreign exchange registration procedures with the national foreign exchange regulatory authority.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Jahwa: H1 2026 net profit of 381 million yuan, up 43.35% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 19 - Shanghai Jahwa announced that for the first half of 2026, operating revenue was RMB 3.791 billion, up 8.99% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 381 million, up 43.35% year-on-year; non-GAAP net profit was RMB 352 million, up 58.92% year-on-year. Net profit for the same period last year was RMB 266 million. The profit distribution plan is a cash dividend of RMB 0.056 per share (tax inclusive). The company plans to sell its 19% equity in Sephora Shanghai and 19% equity in Sephora Beijing to Sephora Asia for EUR 70 million (approximately RMB 555 million). The transaction has been approved by the company's Ninth Board of Directors' ninth meeting and is still subject to shareholder meeting approval and completion of foreign exchange registration procedures with the national foreign exchange regulatory authority.

headlines.summary: 中国银行间市场交易商协会8月19日发布自律处分信息：盛达期货有限公司作为银行间债券市场交易机构，向相关人员出借交易即时通讯工具账户，未就相关产品切实履行主动管理职责，同时存在未按规定实现债券交易业务全程留痕、前后台业务岗位未相互分离的情况。

headlines.title_en: NAFMII: issues severe warning to Shengda Futures
headlines.summary_en: The National Association of Financial Market Institutional Investors (NAFMII) released self-regulatory disciplinary information on August 19: Shengda Futures Co., Ltd., as an interbank bond market trading institution, lent trading instant messaging tool accounts to relevant personnel, failed to effectively fulfill active management responsibilities for related products, and also failed to achieve full traceability of bond trading operations as required and failed to separate front- and back-office job functions.

headlines.title: 金山云：2026年第二季度总收入同比增长30.8%至30.72亿元
headlines.summary: 金山云公告，公司截至2026年6月30日止三个月未经审计财务业绩显示，第二季度总收入达人民币30.72亿元，同比增长30.8%，创历史新高；公有云服务收入为人民币23.58亿元，同比增长45.1%；经营利润为人民币2300万元，去年同期为经营亏损人民币3.27亿元；净亏损为人民币9300万元，较去年同期收窄79.6%。

headlines.title_en: Kingsoft Cloud: Q2 2026 total revenue up 30.8% year-on-year to 3.072 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Kingsoft Cloud announced that its unaudited financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026 show second-quarter total revenue of RMB 3.072 billion, up 30.8% year-on-year, a record high; public cloud services revenue of RMB 2.358 billion, up 45.1% year-on-year; operating profit of RMB 23 million, versus an operating loss of RMB 327 million in the same period last year; and a net loss of RMB 93 million, narrowing by 79.6% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 中微公司：拟投资35亿元建设产业化基地二期项目
headlines.summary: 中微公司公告，公司全资子公司中微临港拟在临港新片区投资建设中微临港产业化基地(二期)项目，项目计划投资人民币35亿元，聚焦刻蚀设备、量检测设备、薄膜沉积设备等优势产品。该事项已获公司第三届董事会第十五次会议审议通过，无需提交股东会审议，不涉及关联交易和重大资产重组。

headlines.title_en: AMEC: plans to invest 3.5 billion yuan in phase II industrial base project
headlines.summary_en: AMEC announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary AMEC Lingang plans to invest in the construction of the AMEC Lingang Industrialization Base (Phase II) project in the Lingang Special Area, with a planned investment of RMB 3.5 billion, focusing on advantaged products such as etch equipment, metrology and inspection equipment, and thin-film deposition equipment. The matter has been approved by the company's Third Board of Directors' fifteenth meeting and does not require shareholder meeting approval, nor does it involve related-party transactions or major asset restructuring.

headlines.title: 上海地铁票价优化方案公布：同步推出计次票，平均每人次票价提高1元左右

headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Development and Reform Commission issued the second announcement on the hearing for optimizing the rail transit fare mechanism, disclosing the list of hearing participants and the hearing plan, and will widely solicit opinions and suggestions from all sectors of society from August 19 to September 6. The public can submit opinions by sending emails or mailing letters.

headlines.title: 深圳机场：2026年上半年净利润7.37亿元，同比增长135.97%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月19日讯，深圳机场公告，2026年上半年营业收入26.83亿元，同比增长6.12%。归属于上市公司股东的净利润7.37亿元，同比增长135.97%。归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润2.68亿元，同比增长2.79%。公司计划不派发现金红利，不送红股，不以公积金转增股本。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen Airport: H1 2026 net profit 737 million yuan, up 135.97% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 19 - Shenzhen Airport announced that for the first half of 2026, operating revenue was RMB 2.683 billion, up 6.12% year-on-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 737 million, up 135.97% year-on-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company excluding non-recurring gains and losses was RMB 268 million, up 2.79% year-on-year. The company plans not to distribute cash dividends, not to issue bonus shares, and not to convert capital reserve into share capital.
